title: Amazon Nearing $7.5 Billion Purchase of Decart
summary: Amazon is nearing a deal to buy Decart, an Israeli AI startup developing video models, for $7.5 billion,the Financial Times reported on Saturday.News that Amazon was considering a Decart purchase was first reported early last month by the Wall Street Journal. The three year old startup has...
title_es: Amazon negocia compra de Decart por $7.500 millones
bajada: Amazon está cerrando un acuerdo para adquirir Decart, startup israelí especializada en modelos de video, por $7.500 millones. La compra refleja la carrera de grandes tech por capacidades de IA de video y control de supply chain.
bajada_en: Amazon is nearing a deal to acquire Decart, an Israeli AI startup focused on video models, for $7.5 billion. The acquisition reflects Big Tech's race to control video AI capabilities and secure supply chain advantages.

title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
summary: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval […]
title_es: Matemático de Anthropic resuelve la hipótesis de Riemann con Claude
bajada: El matemático Levent Alpöge afirma haber probado la hipótesis de Riemann, uno de los problemas sin resolver más antiguos de las matemáticas, con ayuda de Claude. Si se verifica, marcaría un hito significativo en la aplicación de IA a problemas matemáticos fundamentales.
bajada_en: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims to have proved the Riemann hypothesis with Claude's assistance, potentially solving one of mathematics' oldest unsolved problems. If verified, it would demonstrate a major breakthrough in AI-assisted mathematical problem-solving.

title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
summary: Test using prompts with unique, trackable secrets proves that data doesn't stay private.
title_es: Investigador expone filtración masiva de datos en supply chain de IA
bajada: Un investigador plantó 2 millones de 'canarios' (prompts únicos) en la cadena de suministro de IA y descubrió que datos privados se filtran alarmantemente. El experimento prueba que los datos no permanecen privados en los sistemas actuales.
bajada_en: A researcher planted 2 million trackable canaries in the AI supply chain and discovered alarming data leaks. The experiment proves that private data doesn't stay confidential in current systems.

title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
summary: A new report from the AI evaluation nonprofit METR finds that some AI capabilities are continuing to improve along an exponential trajectory—but it also indicates that models aren’t quite as good at tasks that require judgment as they are at coding.  The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely…
title_es: Reporte de METR actualiza el gráfico 'más mal entendido' de IA
bajada: METR publica una actualización mostrando que algunas capacidades de IA siguen trayectorias exponenciales, pero modelos son menos competentes en tareas que requieren juicio que en coding. Una revisión importante del análisis sobre escalado de modelos.
bajada_en: METR releases an updated analysis showing some AI capabilities continue exponential improvement, but models are less capable at judgment-heavy tasks versus coding. An important revision to scaling law understanding.

title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
summary: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a […]
title_es: Trump amenaza con impuesto masivo a datacenters de IA en exterior
bajada: El presidente Trump promete gravar con impuestos 'tremendos' a empresas que construyan datacenters fuera de EE.UU. La amenaza intensifica tensiones regulatorias mientras estados locales también restringen nuevos centros.
bajada_en: President Trump threatens 'tremendous taxes' on companies building AI data centers outside the US. The move escalates regulatory pressures amid local state restrictions on new facilities.

title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
summary: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life. The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to […]
title_es: El dilema de Anthropic: ¿puede costear poner seguridad primero?
bajada: Con su IPO completada, surge la pregunta sobre si Anthropic podrá mantener su enfoque en seguridad mientras enfrenta presiones de rentabilidad del mercado de valores. Un análisis sobre cómo la salida a bolsa podría impactar la estrategia de la empresa.
bajada_en: With its IPO complete, questions emerge about whether Anthropic can maintain its safety-first approach amid market profitability pressures. An analysis of how going public might impact the company's strategic focus.

title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
summary: Signal is limiting users' ability to take screenshots in both its Android and iOS apps.
title_es: Signal restringe screenshots por amenaza existencial de vigilancia con IA
bajada: Signal limitó la capacidad de tomar screenshots en Android e iOS para enfrentar riesgos de vigilancia mediante IA. La medida refleja preocupaciones crecientes sobre cómo modelos de visión pueden analizar capturas de pantalla.
bajada_en: Signal restricted screenshot functionality on Android and iOS to counter AI surveillance risks. The move reflects growing concerns about vision models' ability to analyze screen captures.

title: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
summary: One of the items on the agenda for UN diplomats meeting in Geneva this week was working towards rules regarding the use of autonomous weapons, or so-called "killer robots." Eventually, representatives left the meetings agreeing to "start discussing options" after a largely fruitless week of negotiations. According to NPR: Before the negotiations got underway, the […]
title_es: ONU fracasa en negociaciones sobre regulación de armas autónomas
bajada: Diplomáticos de Naciones Unidas abandonaron reuniones en Ginebra sin acuerdo sobre regulación de armas autónomas, solo acordando 'comenzar a discutir opciones'. El fracaso subraya dificultades en gobernar tecnologías militares de IA.
bajada_en: UN diplomats concluded Geneva meetings on autonomous weapons with no agreement, only committing to 'start discussing options.' The failure highlights challenges in governing military AI technologies.

title: The Outages Are Just Getting Started
summary: AI is forcing companies to patch their systems faster as attackers race to exploit newly discovered vulnerabilities. Welcome to internet outage hell.
title_es: La avalancha de apagones está apenas comenzando
bajada: La aceleración de vulnerabilidades en seguridad impulsada por IA obliga a empresas a parchear sistemas más rápidamente, creando un ciclo de caos de outages. El artículo advierte sobre años de inestabilidad en infraestructura.
bajada_en: AI-driven vulnerability discoveries force companies to patch faster, creating an escalating cycle of outage chaos. Industry faces years of infrastructure instability ahead.

title: firecrawl /firecrawl
summary: 🔥 Firecrawl Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. 🔥 You can use Firecrawl three ways. This repo holds the code for Firecrawl Local and the self-hosted server, along with SDKs that work with all three. Firecrawl Local . Run Firecrawl on your own machine as one binary that turns websites into clean markdown, plugs into your AI agent as an MCP server and serves the Firecrawl API on localhost. Firecrawl Cloud . Use the hosted service at firecrawl.dev for everything Local does at scale with nothing to run, plus search and the 550+ data providers in Firecrawl Alexandria for far more knowledge than scraping alone. Self-hosting . Deploy the full Firecrawl server from apps/api with its own queues, workers and databases on your own infrastructure. Pst. Hey, you, join our stargazers :) Firecrawl Local Firecrawl Local scrapes, crawls and maps from your own machine without a database, queue or container, and it reaches Firecrawl Cloud when your AI agents need search or Alexandria. It installs from crates.io. You need Rust and a C compiler, which on macOS means xcode-select --install and on Debian or Ubuntu means build-essential . cargo install firecrawl-local If you don't have Rust, Firecrawl Cloud runs the same scrape with nothing to build and no signup. npx -y firecrawl-cli@latest scrape https://firecrawl.dev Scrape a page and print its markdown. firecrawl-local scrape https://firecrawl.dev --markdown Crawl a site and save one markdown file per page. firecrawl-local crawl https://docs.firecrawl.dev --limit 50 --out ./pages List every URL on a site. firecrawl-local map https://firecrawl.dev Pages that need JavaScript render in the Chrome or Chromium already on your machine, and PDFs and Office documents are parsed locally too. Without a browser, static pages still work and a page that needed one comes back with a warning. Add it to your AI agent init finds Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI and Codex on your machine and adds Firecrawl Loca
title_es: Firecrawl: infraestructura open-source para potenciar agentes IA
bajada: Firecrawl es una herramienta open-source que convierte sitios web en markdown limpio para alimentar agentes IA, con versiones local, cloud y auto-hospedada. Útil para developers que construyen sistemas que requieren conocimiento web actualizado.
bajada_en: Firecrawl is an open-source tool that converts websites into clean markdown for AI agents, with local, cloud, and self-hosted options. Essential for developers building knowledge-aware AI systems.

title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
summary: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.
title_es: Guía de agentes IA que funcionan dentro de mensajes de texto
bajada: TechCrunch recopila los agentes IA más notables que operan en SMS, desde asistentes generales hasta especializados para familias, viajes y trabajo. Una muestra del crecimiento de IA conversacional integrada en canales existentes.
bajada_en: TechCrunch compiles the most notable AI agents operating in text messages, from general assistants to specialized versions for families, travel, and work. A snapshot of conversational AI growth in existing channels.

title: Is selling an AI version of your face to this microdrama startup the future of Hollywood?
summary: An actor has licensed his face to a microdrama startup — in a trend that's already popular in China. Experts question the long-term consequences if this becomes a trend in Hollywood, too.
title_es: ¿Es vender tu rostro IA a startups el futuro de Hollywood?
bajada: Un actor licenció su rostro a una startup de microdramas en tendencia que ya es popular en China. Expertos cuestionan las consecuencias de largo plazo si esto se populariza en Hollywood.
bajada_en: An actor licensed his AI-generated face to a microdrama startup in a trend already popular in China. Experts question long-term consequences if this becomes mainstream in Hollywood.

title: A tale of two Nvidias
summary: We got two very different pictures of Nvidia —  the company’s latest earnings report vs. the tech executives loudly calling for Jensen Huang’s return.
title_es: Dos Nvidias: resultados vs. llamados por regreso de Jensen Huang
bajada: Reporte de ganancias de Nvidia versus ejecutivos del sector pidiendo el regreso de Jensen Huang pintan dos imágenes contradictorias. Un análisis de las tensiones internas y percepciones del liderazgo.
bajada_en: Nvidia's earnings report versus tech executives calling for Jensen Huang's return paint contradictory pictures of the company. An analysis of internal tensions and leadership perceptions.

title: openvinotoolkit /openvino
summary: Open-source software toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models. Documentation • Blog • Key Features • Tutorials • Integrations • Benchmarks • Generative AI Inference Optimization : Boost deep learning performance in computer vision, automatic speech recognition, generative AI, natural language processing with large and small language models, and many other common tasks. Flexible Model Support : Use models trained with popular frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle, and JAX/Flax. Directly integrate models built with transformers and diffusers from the Hugging Face Hub using Optimum Intel. Convert and deploy models without original frameworks. Broad Platform Compatibility : Reduce resource demands and efficiently deploy on a range of platforms from edge to cloud. OpenVINO™ supports inference on CPU (x86, ARM), GPU (Intel integrated & discrete GPU) and AI accelerators (Intel NPU). Community and Ecosystem : Join an active community contributing to the enhancement of deep learning performance across various domains. title_es: OpenVINO: toolkit open-source para optimizar e desplegar modelos deep learning
bajada: OpenVINO es un toolkit de Intel para optimizar e desplegar modelos de deep learning en múltiples plataformas desde edge a cloud. Soporta frameworks populares y acelera inference en CPUs, GPUs y NPUs.
bajada_en: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning models across edge-to-cloud platforms. Supports major frameworks and accelerates inference on CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs.
